title: R-universality of an odd-dimensional special orthogonal Lie algebra in terms of the even Clifford algebra
author: Dave Witte Morris
work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for an odd-dimensional special orthogonal Lie algebra (author prop at source lines 632-636): universality holds exactly when the even Clifford algebra of the symmetric matrix splits over Q or fails to split over R. The proof (source lines 638-641) is short and reduces the whole criterion to a single Brauer class: the oddness of n makes the centre of the spin group of order two, so only one Tits algebra occurs, and that algebra is Brauer equivalent to the even Clifford algebra, whose splitting behaviour over the two fields is exactly the stated alternative. The card keeps the author's own level of detail. H2.
